title: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.28892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old state, we translate the new domain into the model's pre-existing knowledge space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures. Therefore, we propose Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that transports new knowledge into the model's existing skill space. translated_title: 通过知识重塑对抗持续领域自适应中的灾难性遗忘
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28892v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在后训练阶段将语言模型适配到新领域时，存在损害模型既有能力的风险，这一现象通常被称为灾难性遗忘。现有的缓解方法大多将遗忘视为模型过度漂移的后果，因此通过保留旧输出、重放旧数据，或对参数和表示的变化进行正则化来约束更新，以使更新后的模型保持接近其先前的状态。我们采取了不同的视角：与其把更新后的模型拉回其旧状态，不如将新领域转换到模型已有的知识空间中，使陌生的知识能够通过熟悉的过程被学习。为此，我们提出了技能模式传输（SST），这是一个将新知识传输至模型既有技能空间的后训练框架。SST 将每种示例类型抽象为一个技能模式，保留其核心操作、依赖关系以及……
tldr: 该论文提出技能模式传输框架，通过将新领域知识转换到模型已有的技能空间中、使陌生知识借助熟悉的过程被学习，从而在持续领域自适应中有效对抗灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that combats catastrophic forgetting by transporting new domain knowledge into the model's existing skill space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures.
